PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: character-abraham-patriarch-freed-appearance
Workflow profile: 4X3 (4:3)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Character guard: the row alone defines identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, hair, scars, costume, wounds, pose, and carried objects. Never turn a non-Jesus character into a Jesus lookalike.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested production-sheet spacing/readability only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
ABRAHAM - PATRIARCH FREED — APPEARANCE: FOUR-VIEW IDENTITY, ANATOMY, COSTUME, AND CONTINUITY REFERENCE.

Create a four-view cinematic character ingredients sheet showing the same person in frontal three-quarter portrait, full-body, side profile, and rear-head/costume view. Lock facial identity, age, ethnicity, hairline, complete crown and rear hair, costume construction, body proportions, hands, scars, wounds, and carried props across every panel. One face exists only on the front of the head. Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Abraham, the ancient patriarch of faith, at the exact screenplay moment he is freed in Hell's inner chamber: old but dignified, eyes sharp with recognition of the Redeemer and the divine plan he waited ages to see fulfilled. Photorealistic live-action biblical epic character ingredients identity lock of one continuous human being across four production views.

Identity and physique: elderly Near Eastern Semitic man approximately seventy-to-ninety in appearance, height five feet ten inches (178 cm), lean angular frame that still holds noble upright posture rather than bent frailty. Shoulders still square; spine long; gait implied as measured and patriarchal. Skin is sun-weathered Mediterranean olive-bronze with deep freckling of age, fine parchment texture across cheekbones and forehead, visible pores, subtle liver spots on hands and temples, and a thin film of ancient dust that has not yet fully fallen away after millennia in the prison of the dead. Subsurface scattering in the thinner skin of eyelids and ear rims under warm divine fill. No modern grooming; no jewelry; no prosthetic age makeup look—true aged flesh.

Head and hair: complete crown coverage of long white hair the color of sun-bleached bone and winter frost, dense at the temples and crown, flowing past the nape to mid-back and upper shoulders, slightly wavy with natural separation strands rather than stiff white wig blocks. Rear head fully covered in the same continuous white hair mass so the back view never shows bare scalp or a second face. Long white beard, full and patriarchal, carefully tended even in bondage—clean jawline undergrowth fading into a soft white cloud that reaches mid-chest, with subtle silver-gray depth near the lips and a natural split at the chin tip. Mustache blends into beard without hard edges. Eyebrows thick, pale, slightly arched with intelligence rather than fury. One human face only, centered on the front of the head: high thoughtful forehead, deep-set eyes under heavy lids, strong aquiline nose with a slight ancient break ridge, hollowed but dignified cheeks, firm mouth capable of quiet speech, vertical nasolabial folds, and soft crow's feet that read as wisdom earned, not cartoon age.

Eyes and expression: sharp intelligent dark brown irises with clear wet catchlights, pupils reacting to sudden golden divine radiance after ages of dim blue torch gloom. Expression is profound peace and acceptance braided with instantaneous recognition—he knows who stands before him; the covenant mind understands the plan in a single look. No comic shock, no gaping mouth; a quiet patriarchal certainty, eyes slightly widened with sacred recognition, brows lifted a millimeter, mouth soft and closed in reverence. Tear tracks optional and minimal—one thin clean path through dust on the left cheek only if present, never both eyes streaming.

Hands and body details: large lean hands with long fingers, prominent tendons and knuckles, fine white hairs on the backs of the hands, clean fingernails shortened by wear, faint iron-chain pressure bands still pink-gray around both wrists where manacles have just fallen away—subtle circular indentations and lighter skin, not open wounds or gore. Forearms spare and corded. Bare or simply sandaled feet (rough leather thong sandals, soles worn thin, natural fiber stitching) consistent across views. No carried props; Abraham is stripped to spiritual essentials, differentiated from Moses (no staff), David (no harp), Elijah and John (no animal skins).

Costume construction—simple shepherd's garments in natural fibers, worn but maintaining patriarchal dignity: ankle-length outer robe of undyed coarse wool-linen blend in warm sand, raw umber, and soft bone-beige tones, hand-woven plain weave with visible irregular thread thickness, small repairs and careful darning at hem and left sleeve, frayed lower edge that brushes the tops of the sandals, dust and ash ground into the weave at knees and hem from kneeling in the chamber of the dead. Under-tunic of finer natural linen in cream-ivory, visible at neckline and sleeve openings, slightly cleaner than the outer robe. Soft leather cord belt cinched at the natural waist with a simple bone or wood toggle, no metal buckles, no ornament. Fabric hangs with real weight and soft vertical folds; translucency only where thin linen catches backlight at the sleeve edges. Costume must lock identically across frontal three-quarter portrait, full-body, side profile, and rear costume views: same belt knot side, same darn on left sleeve, same hem damage map, same dust pattern density.

Pose and state by panel: frontal three-quarter portrait from chest up, head turned a few degrees toward camera-right as if regarding the approaching light of Christ, shoulders relaxed, hands not raised in theatrics—perhaps one hand half-lifted near the sternum in quiet assent. Full-body standing upright on black stone that is beginning to take a faint warm marble sheen, weight evenly distributed, robe hanging true, wrists free of chains with broken link fragments on the floor nearby as optional environmental hint only. Side profile pure silhouette of the noble nose, flowing white beard line, and robe drape, hair crown continuous front to rear. Rear-head and costume view shows complete white hair coverage over the occiput and nape, no face on the back of the head, rear belt knot, spine of the robe, and shoulder blades under cloth.

Environment context: Hell's vast inner prison chamber at the liberation beat—cavernous black stone pillars receding into soft darkness behind the subject, residual cold blue torch light still dying in distant sconces while warm ethereal gold and pure white divine radiance (approximately 6500K god-ray key with amber fill near 3500–4500K) floods from the direction of the shattered gate and the Harrower's presence. Atmosphere of settling ash dust motes in volumetric beams, faint perfume warmth replacing poison air, no guardian figures, no other hero faces competing for identity. Background stays soft and secondary so Abraham remains the sole locked identity.

Lighting and camera language: soft high-key divine key from upper front-left with gentle facial modeling, cool residual blue rim from far hell torches on the opposite shoulder edge for color contrast of the beat, warm amber bounce from stone floor. Photoreal subsurface skin, fabric micro-texture, individual white hair strands catching gold rims. Production reference framing for a four-view ingredients sheet: even, readable lighting on all panels, consistent scale, shallow depth of field only enough to separate subject from background, cinematic still photographic quality as if captured on large-format cinema glass for a 2.39:1 biblical epic, not illustration, not anime, not CGI cartoon, not oil painting. Color grade: ethereal golds (#FFD700), warm amber (#FFBF00), residual deep crimson and obsidian of hell architecture, pale sand and bone costume neutrals, white hair reading pure against the dark chamber.

Continuity locks to repeat: elderly patriarch Abraham; long well-groomed white hair with full crown and rear coverage; long white patriarchal beard; sharp intelligent dark eyes of recognition and peace; lean noble 5'10" posture; simple worn shepherd robe and under-tunic in natural undyed fibers with leather cord belt; subtle freed-wrist chain marks; no staff, no harp, no animal skins, no modern objects; one face only on the front of the head; photoreal live-action sacred biblical epic tone. No captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no readable text, no UI, no celebrity likeness, no second face on the rear of the skull.
